question: Which Shudra devotees of Maheshvara are included in this rule?
premises: Some individuals are devotees of Maheshvara.
These devotees belong to the Shudra class.
They wear ash and rudraksha beads.
inference: Shudra devotees of Maheshvara who wear ash and rudraksha are included.
plain_english: And those Shudras who are devotees of Maheshvara and wear ash and rudraksha beads.
